attributes.content:
# Ensure shell scripts always use LF line endings regardless of OS
*.sh text eol=lf

# Python files use LF
*.py text eol=lf

# Default: auto-detect text files and normalize to LF on checkout
* text=auto eol=lf

# Task-template fragments retain separators from composed prompts verbatim.
src/prompts/task_templates/*.md whitespace=-blank-at-eol,-blank-at-eof
# Descriptor source fragments retain the original separators when concatenated.
tests/fixtures/generated_sources/command_descriptors/*.py.inc whitespace=-blank-at-eof

# Generated artifacts: pure functions of the source, rebuilt by
# scripts/regenerate-generated.sh (keep its GENERATED list in step; see
# tests/test_generated_artifacts.py).  Never hand-merge them: take either side,
# resolve the source files, run the script and commit what it writes.
# `merge=aq-generated` names a driver the development publisher defines when it
# merges task branches (keeping our side after validating reviewed bookkeeping
# provenance), after which it regenerates these files. Where the driver is not
# defined, Git falls back to its ordinary text merge.
tests/selection_catalogue.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/reference/cli-command-inventory.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/reference/configuration-schema.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/reference/promotion-flow-schema.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/reference/playbook-commands/README.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/playbook_v2_schema.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/tools/command_catalogue.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
openapi.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
packages/aq-client/** merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
scripts/aq-client-boilerplate.sha256 merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
# Bazel graph: the manifest and the suite/test BUILD files are pure functions of the
# sources plus the manifest's retained collection (scripts/bazel/generate_targets.py).
tools/bazel/test_suites.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/BUILD.bazel merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
checks/BUILD.bazel merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/integration_ownership.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/integration_ownership_report.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/generated_sources/ownership/integration_ownership.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/generated_sources/ownership/integration_ownership_report.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/contracts/generated-command-audit.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/test_command_descriptors.py merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
# Approved policy and provenance live in the authored module shards and
# playbook recordings. Only their deterministic projections are disposable.
tests/fixtures/playbooks/v2/*/artifact.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/playbooks/v2/*/artifact.sha256 merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/playbooks/v2/*/source.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/playbooks/v2/*/manifest.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
tests/fixtures/playbooks/v2/*/diagnostics.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/prompts/reviewed_playbooks/*/artifact.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/prompts/reviewed_playbooks/*/artifact.sha256 merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/prompts/reviewed_playbooks/*/source.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/prompts/reviewed_playbooks/*/manifest.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
src/prompts/reviewed_playbooks/*/diagnostics.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/integration-only/default-pipeline/artifact.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/integration-only/default-pipeline/artifact.sha256 merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/integration-only/default-pipeline/source.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/integration-only/default-pipeline/manifest.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/shared-fleet/default-assignment-routing/artifact.json merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/shared-fleet/default-assignment-routing/artifact.sha256 merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/shared-fleet/default-assignment-routing/source.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated
docs/playbooks/shared-fleet/default-assignment-routing/manifest.md merge=aq-generated linguist-generated

# Hand-maintained, but branches almost only append module globs and areas to
# it: keep both sides' lines instead of conflicting.
tests/selection_areas.yaml merge=union
